name: Locale switcher is present in the nav and offers all three languages
description: A nav-level locale switcher (dropdown or three-button toggle) must be visible on the page and offer at least the three supported locales (English, Spanish, Portuguese). A site with no switcher control, or one that only lists a single language, fails this test.

planSteps.description: Locate the language/locale switcher control in the navigation bar

Verify a locale switcher exists in the nav and exposes three selectable language options (English/es/pt or equivalent labels/flags plus language names). If no switcher control is present, or it offers fewer than three languages, the test fails.
